_reduction_rule: Retained every CYP2C19 recommendation row for clopidogrel across all populations and the Normal/Intermediate/Poor phenotype families - the rows the shipped CSV generalises. Dropped rows for phenotypes the app does not call. Complete with respect to the populations and phenotypes any claim here rests on.

rows.drugrecommendation: If considering clopidogrel, use at standard dose (75 mg/day)
rows.implications: Normal clopidogrel active metabolite formation; normal on-treatment platelet reactivity

rows.drugrecommendation: Avoid standard dose clopidogrel (75 mg) if possible. Use prasugrel or ticagrelor at standard dose if no contraindication.
rows.implications: Reduced clopidogrel active metabolite formation; increased on-treatment platelet reactivity; increased risk for adverse cardiac and cerebrovascular events
